1) there are significant differences between different similarity metrics and 2) there is a correlation of the similarity metric with the user’s perception of relevance.

the correlation of user perceived similarity and distance metrics is not very high, that there are some metrics that correlate better than others, and that there is a need for further research on metrics for relevance assessment in the MPEG-7 context.
